sequence.description: Opening title card with the question

sequence.quote: My first concert was in a tiny club in Hamburg. I was fifteen and I didn't know any of the songs.
sequence.context: Answer to the interviewer's first question; sets up the story.

sequence.quote: Everybody was jumping, the floor was shaking. That night I knew I wanted to be on that stage.
sequence.context: Same answer, after a digression about the club (cut); the turning point of the story.

sequence.quote: Mine was a stadium show with my dad. Honestly, I was bored. Small clubs are where it happens.
sequence.context: Contrasting answer from Band B to the same question; closes the short.

broll.description: Jumping crowd, illustrates "the floor was shaking"
